reply_text:
I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

The source is her own post in #central-team on 9 June. She wrote that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver arrived at 7:10 and his trailer number was written on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem with the store login. I couldn't find any follow-up on that in the channel, and I told her so.

There are no Marrow Agrisupply account files I can see.
